relationships.rationale: Thread/worktree deletion and SCM branch removal share one destructive boundary and must reconcile partial failures.
The closed primary-mode vocabulary constrains natural-language overlay resolution and visible labels.
Wizard escalation can carry clarification state, so questionnaire resume and handoff idempotency must agree.
Targeted annotation revision mutates the same plan artifact and normalized TODO projection that gates execution.
Fresh retrieval and durable Assistant memory are separate context sources assembled under different trust and propagation rules.
The Context Detail Pane presents bounded usage and Investigation Context records without owning their storage truth.
Terminal command cards are a specialized operation presentation while the shell retains session authority.
Parallel orchestration extends the canonical child-run identity, status, card, and parent-mediation model.
Crew is an attributable overlay over child orchestration and inherits the parent authority ceiling.
Context Lens shaping and Subcompact summaries feed the deterministic assembly and repack pipeline.
Virtualized rendering depends on paging and hot-memory eviction to bound long-thread resource use.
Jump, search, and anchor restoration depend on stable IDs and measured-height virtualization state.
Auditor settings consume the same account-bound provider/model registry and capability resolver used by Chat.
Runtime disclosure surfaces the effective result of Persona selection, override, eligibility, and fallback resolution.
Sandbox bridge authentication, sanitization, and method authority govern the interactive visualizer surface.
The visualizer surface depends on verifiable bundled libraries and governed source/export artifact lifecycles.
A recommendation remains a user-controlled CTA; acceptance starts the separate Wizard handoff lifecycle.
